# Banana Trading Company

- Build a polished React + TypeScript Vite single-page game.
- Keep the trading loop fair: include fees, slippage, supply constraints, and price bounds.
- Persist player progress locally unless the user explicitly requests otherwise.
- Favor clear state transitions and deterministic helpers for market logic.
- Keep the UI bold, readable, and responsive.
- Add concise comments only when the logic is non-obvious.
